title: Add project task boards and research execution history
question: Can visitors follow project-scoped task IDs, status and recorded research steps in a Jira-style board?
rationale: User asked for per-project task IDs and a task-centric progress/history view; explicitly rejected promotional copy.
next_action: Research agents use new, task and exec; commit ledger updates to main for automatic publication.
notes: Task board, persistent project keys and direct CLI-driven status/history implemented. Actual tests, independent reviews, browser checks and deployment evidence are linked through the assigned RUN.
success_criteria: Persist readable project-scoped task aliases while preserving canonical UUIDs.
Display real tasks in Open, In progress, Blocked and Completed columns with project/search filters.
Show task detail, criteria, next action, linked runs/results/reviews and recorded command steps.
Replace slogans with factual interface text and deploy tested changes.
resource_limit: Task-board improvement only; no mathematical research.
